page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage options. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 28 Gbps. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, the ecs.r9i.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for hosting large-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications.
